name: 黄金时刻
prompt_en: golden hour light, low warm sun, long soft shadows, 3200K warmth
prompt_zh: 低角度暖阳，长而柔和的影子

name: 蓝调时刻
prompt_en: blue hour, deep blue ambient after sunset, city lights just on
prompt_zh: 日落后深蓝环境光，城市灯初亮

name: 破晓
prompt_en: first light of dawn, cool pale sky, soft directional glow
prompt_zh: 破晓初光，冷调淡天，柔和方向光

name: 正午硬光
prompt_en: harsh midday sun, short hard shadows overhead, high contrast
prompt_zh: 正午烈日，短硬阴影，高对比

name: 黄昏
prompt_en: dusk, orange gradient sky, silhouettes forming
prompt_zh: 黄昏橙调渐变天空，剪影成形

name: 夜晚
prompt_en: night scene, practical lights only, deep shadows
prompt_zh: 夜景，仅实用光源，深阴影

name: 阴天
prompt_en: overcast diffused light, no hard shadows, flat soft illumination
prompt_zh: 阴天漫射光，无硬阴影，平淡柔和

name: 室内混合
prompt_en: mixed indoor lighting, warm practical lamp plus cool window light
prompt_zh: 室内混合光，暖色台灯加冷色窗光

name: 正面主光
prompt_en: frontal key light, evenly lit face, minimal shadow
prompt_zh: 正面主光，面部均匀受光

name: 侧光
prompt_en: side key light, half the face in shadow, sculpted features
prompt_zh: 侧主光，半脸在阴影中，轮廓立体

name: 轮廓光
prompt_en: rim light from behind, glowing edge separating subject from background
prompt_zh: 背侧轮廓光，发光边缘分离主体与背景

name: 逆光
prompt_en: backlit, subject silhouetted against bright background, lens flare
prompt_zh: 逆光剪影，背景明亮带镜头光晕

name: 顶光
prompt_en: top light from directly overhead, eyes in shadow, stark
prompt_zh: 正上方顶光，眼部在阴影中

name: 底光
prompt_en: uplight from below, shadows cast upward, unsettling
prompt_zh: 下方上打光，阴影向上投射，不安

name: 低调硬光
prompt_en: low-key lighting, single hard source, deep black shadows
prompt_zh: 低调布光，单一硬光源，深黑阴影

name: 高调柔光
prompt_en: high-key lighting, bright even fill, minimal shadow, airy
prompt_zh: 高调布光，明亮均匀填充，几乎无阴影

name: 柔光箱
prompt_en: large softbox, wrap-around soft light, gentle falloff
prompt_zh: 大型柔光箱，包裹式柔光，柔和衰减

name: 实用光源
prompt_en: motivated by practical sources visible in frame, lamp, neon, screen glow
prompt_zh: 由画面内可见光源驱动：台灯、霓虹、屏幕光

name: 闪烁
prompt_en: light flickers irregularly throughout the shot
prompt_zh: 光线整段不规则闪烁

name: 扫光
prompt_en: a beam of light sweeps slowly across the frame
prompt_zh: 一束光缓慢扫过画面

name: 渐亮
prompt_en: the room gradually brightens from dark as light rises
prompt_zh: 房间由暗渐亮

name: 渐暗
prompt_en: light gradually fades until the subject is nearly in darkness
prompt_zh: 光线渐暗直至主体近乎没入黑暗

name: 阴影推移
prompt_en: shadows slowly lengthen and move across the wall
prompt_zh: 阴影缓慢拉长并在墙上移动

name: 霓虹脉动
prompt_en: neon sign pulses in the background, casting shifting colored light
prompt_zh: 背景霓虹招牌脉动，投下流动彩光

name: 火光
prompt_en: flickering firelight from off-frame, warm orange dancing on faces
prompt_zh: 画外火光摇曳，暖橙光在脸上跳动

name: 闪电
prompt_en: a lightning flash briefly illuminates the scene, then darkness returns
prompt_zh: 闪电短暂照亮场景后重归黑暗

name: 冷调
prompt_en: cool color grade, blue-teal shadows, desaturated warmth
prompt_zh: 冷色分级，蓝青阴影，暖色去饱和

name: 暖调
prompt_en: warm color grade, amber highlights, soft skin tones
prompt_zh: 暖色分级，琥珀高光，柔和肤色

name: 低饱和
prompt_en: muted desaturated palette, restrained color
prompt_zh: 低饱和克制配色

name: 高饱和
prompt_en: vivid saturated colors, punchy grade
prompt_zh: 鲜艳饱和，冲击力强

name: 青橙对冲
prompt_en: teal shadows with orange skin tones, blockbuster grade
prompt_zh: 青色阴影配橙色肤色，商业大片调色

name: 近乎黑白
prompt_en: near-monochrome, single accent color, high contrast
prompt_zh: 近黑白，单一强调色，高对比

name: 奶油调
prompt_en: soft pastel palette, low contrast, hazy highlights
prompt_zh: 柔和奶油配色，低对比，朦胧高光

name: 水墨
prompt_en: ink-wash aesthetic, black and grey with ink diffusion, rice paper texture
prompt_zh: 水墨美学，黑白灰墨韵扩散，宣纸质感

name: 霓虹
prompt_en: neon-drenched, magenta and cyan glow, wet reflective surfaces
prompt_zh: 霓虹浸染，品红与青色辉光，湿润反光表面

name: 烛光
prompt_en: candlelit, warm pools of light in deep darkness
prompt_zh: 烛光照明，深黑暗中暖色光池

name: 月光
prompt_en: cold moonlight, silver-blue rim on subjects
prompt_zh: 冷月光，主体银蓝轮廓

name: 丁达尔
prompt_en: volumetric light beams, visible dust particles in the air
prompt_zh: 体积光束，空气中可见尘埃

name: 雾气
prompt_en: atmospheric fog, reduced visibility, layered depth
prompt_zh: 大气雾气，能见度降低，层次纵深

name: 雨夜
prompt_en: rain-slicked surfaces, reflective ground, streaks on lens
prompt_zh: 雨水湿滑表面，地面反光，镜头雨痕

name: 烟雾
prompt_en: hazy smoke filling the space, light diffused through it
prompt_zh: 烟雾弥漫空间，光线穿透漫射

name: 柔光晕
prompt_en: dreamy bloom, halation around highlights, soft glow
prompt_zh: 梦幻柔光晕，高光周围光晕扩散
